_comment: Reviewed keep set for run_4, from results/run_4/pair_screening.md. Consumed by 04_truth_direction.ipynb.
criterion: keep_pairs: LABEL-BLIND. A pair is kept when both halves produce a coherent display that commits to a readable position on this specific evidence. Dropped only for incoherence, degenerate repetition, off-topic content, or self-contradiction that makes the asserted answer unreadable. Whether the display contradicts the truth label played no part. probe_ids: STRICT and behaviour-conditioned on purpose - display asserts the wrong answer, drawn from the held-out split.

dropped.in_07: yes-half incoherent: 'The time of death is not the same as the time of death'; no assertion recoverable
dropped.in_19: no-half degenerate: 'consistent with a knife being used in a crime scene and then being washed' repeated three times
dropped.in_22: no-half is off-topic: display is about three individuals attending monthly committee meetings, unrelated to dental records
dropped.out_02: yes-half is a truncated encyclopedia dump on copper that never answers the question
dropped.out_07: yes-half self-contradictory and factually incoherent ('fourth-largest of the world's five oceans'; 'not an ocean in the sense of...')
dropped.out_15: yes-half self-contradictory: 'No, a kilometre is 1,000 metres, so it is longer'
dropped.out_27: no-half opens 'Yes, 15 is an odd number' to 'Is 15 an even number?'; asserted answer unreadable

probe_note: All four are in the test split and all four invert. in_25_yes 'The badge is a false positive' and in_32_yes 'not admissible in court' deny affirmative evidence; in_41_no 'consistent with a return before the theft' and in_15_no 'the mismatch is a false positive' assert a link where there is none, so both polarities are represented.
covariate_note: display_inverted_* is the behavioural covariate, NOT a filter. Use it to split the kept set and check the direction separates within both subgroups: if it tracks ground truth it does; if it tracks the displayed answer it flips sign between them.
